bernstein_derivative_atom: lambda/(x+lambda)^2 = integral_0^infinity lambda t exp(-(x+lambda)t) dt
equal_rate_fiber: conditioning two Gamma(shape=2,rate=lambda) atoms on T+U=v gives density proportional to t(v-t), hence T/v is Beta(2,2)
exchange_pair_fiber: rates lambda,mu plus exchanged rates give density proportional to t(v-t) cosh((lambda-mu)(t-v/2))
spread_monotonicity: relative to the Beta(2,2) fiber, the cosh tilt is even and increasing in |t-v/2|, so covariance with (t-v/2)^2 is nonnegative
mixture: all exchange-paired components have conditional mean v/2 and variance at least v^2/20; positive mixtures preserve the bound
consequence: a positive Stieltjes measure implies the fiber-spread condition and therefore rank-two Schwarzian positivity
acceptance_test: Construct the positive Stieltjes measure from the completed arithmetic source without assuming the zero set.
